fields.description: The DocType that a Link field points to. Child tables and singles cannot be matched.
fields.label: DocType

fields.description: Comma-separated fields of the linked DocType that are matched exactly, for example a reference number. Each field needs Search Index or Unique turned on.
fields.label: Identifier Fields

fields.description: Match the title field approximately, using the Fuzzy Match Threshold from LlamaIndex Settings. The linked DocType needs a short title field.
fields.label: Fuzzy Match

fields.description: Match a Contact whose email is the sender's address, then use the record that Contact is linked to.
fields.label: Match Sender Contact

fields.description: Create a record when nothing matches and its required fields have values. The new record is flagged for review.
fields.label: Auto-create

fields.description: JSON object that maps each extracted key to the field of the linked DocType that it fills. The object key is the extracted key and the value is the linked fieldname, so {"uom": "stock_uom"} fills stock_uom from the extracted uom. A linked field that is not a value here is filled from the extracted key of the same name.
fields.label: Field Map

fields.description: JSON object of values for auto-created records, keyed by fieldname of the linked DocType. For example {"fieldname": "value"}.
fields.label: Default Values
